text: Hey!
zh: 嘿！

text: What are you doing here in this camp?
zh: 你在这营地里做什么？

text: You don't look like one of my men.
zh: 你看着可不像我的手下。

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: I am just passing through.
zh: 我只是路过。

text: I am looking for a coin.
zh: 我在找一枚硬币。

text: Passing through?
zh: 路过？

text: A coin?
zh: 一枚硬币？

text: He should be here already.
zh: 他这会儿早该到了。

text: Looks like you're stuck here, then.
zh: 那看来你是被困在这儿了。

text: My men have the #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#mine locked down#text.default#, #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#bandits#text.default# are occupying the #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#northern mountain pass#text.default# and the #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#eastern bridge#text.default# is #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#destroyed#text.default#.
zh: 我的手下已经把#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#矿井封锁#text.default#了，#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#强盗#text.default#占据着#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#北方山口#text.default#，而#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#东边的桥#text.default#也已经#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#被毁#text.default#了。

text: You better go back to wherever you came from.
zh: 你最好从哪儿来回哪儿去。

text: Don't think you should be begging around here, friend.
zh: 朋友，这里可不是你讨饭的地方。

text: Keep your distance from the camp, we don't have anything to give to you.
zh: 离营地远点，我们没什么可施舍你的。

text: Now, is there anything else?
zh: 那么，还有别的事吗？

text: I am looking for a specific coin?
zh: 我在找一枚特别的硬币。

text: Alright!
zh: 好吧！

text: Do I look like a coin collector?
zh: 我看着像收藏硬币的吗？

text: #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#Themir#text.default# - our wizard - may be able to help you.
zh: #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#塞米尔#text.default#——我们的法师——也许能帮你。

text: Themir was out for a walk or something, he tends to disappear at times.
zh: 塞米尔出去散步还是干什么去了，他时不时就会消失一阵。

text: I sent men to look for him, but they also didn't return.
zh: 我派人去找过他，可他们也没回来。

text: I can't afford to send more of my men, so that's where you come in.
zh: 我不能再派更多手下去了，所以就轮到你出场了。

text: He should be here in the camp again.
zh: 他应该已经回到营地了。

text: If I knew where to find him, he wouldn't be missing, right?
zh: 我要是知道上哪儿找他，他就不算失踪了，对吧？

text: Ask the people outside the camp.
zh: 去问问营地外面的人。

text: Maybe, one of them saw him.
zh: 也许有人见过他。

text: I am looking for Themir.
zh: 我在找塞米尔。

text: Do you know where I could find Themir?
zh: 你知道我在哪儿能找到塞米尔吗？

text: Themir is dead.
zh: 塞米尔死了。

text: Why did you close the mine?
zh: 你为什么封锁矿井？

text: I want to join your camp!
zh: 我想加入你们的营地！

text: I have information about the king's plans.
zh: 我有关于国王计划的情报。

text: I'll open the mine.
zh: 我去打开矿井。

text: I found Randolph.
zh: 我找到兰道夫了。

text: Randolph is back in camp.
zh: 兰道夫回营地了。

text: The mine is now free.
zh: 矿井已经安全了。

text: I heard about your fight with Goran.
zh: 我听说了你和戈兰的争斗。

text: Jens is busy fishing instead of repairing the bridge.
zh: 延斯光顾着钓鱼，没在修桥。

text: What do you think about this letter?
zh: 你觉得这封信怎么样？

text: I seek combat training.
zh: 我想接受战斗训练。

text: Let us train.
zh: 我们来训练吧。

text: See you later!
zh: 回头见！

text: #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#Themir#text.default# - our wizard - told me to close the mine.
zh: #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#塞米尔#text.default#——我们的法师——让我封锁矿井。

text: Until he tells me to open it again, the mine will stay closed.
zh: 除非他让我重新打开，否则矿井会一直封着。

text: Listen. Themir told me...
zh: 听着，塞米尔跟我说……

text: Themir already gave me the key.
zh: 塞米尔已经把钥匙给我了。

text: Very well, then.
zh: 那好吧。

text:
But be aware.
We haven't been in the mine for a while.
zh:
但你要当心。
我们已经有段时间没进过矿井了。

text:
Themir's magic barely scratched those things in the mine.
However, our swords and axes proved far more reliable.
zh:
塞米尔的魔法对矿井里那些东西几乎不起作用。
倒是我们的刀剑斧头可靠得多。

text: Thing is, he usually comes back. This time he didn't.
zh: 问题是，他通常都会回来。这次却没有。

text: Help me find Themir!
zh: 帮我找到塞米尔！

text: It wouldn't surprise me if it's full of monsters again.
zh: 就算里面又挤满了怪物，我也不会意外。

text: Bold of you to show your face here again, after all you've done!
zh: 你干了那些好事，居然还敢在这儿露面！

text: Either pay up for the damage you caused, or you can consider yourself exiled!
zh: 要么赔偿你造成的损失，要么就当自己被驱逐了吧！

text: How much do I have to pay?
zh: 我得付多少钱？

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: Then get the hell out of my camp!
zh: 那就滚出我的营地！

text: Based on what you did...
zh: 按你干的好事来算……

text: Here's the 100 gold.
zh: 这是100金币。

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: Here's the 200 gold.
zh: 这是200金币。

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: Here's the 300 gold.
zh: 这是300金币。

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: Here's the 400 gold.
zh: 这是400金币。

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: Here's the 500 gold.
zh: 这是500金币。

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text:
You're lucky you can...
Next time I won't be so lax.
Don't do it again!
zh:
算你走运，还付得起……
下次我可不会这么好说话。
别再犯了！

text: I can show you how to fight properly.
zh: 我可以教你怎么正经地战斗。

text: How about some gold?
zh: 给点金币怎么样？

text: I cleared the mine.
zh: 我清理了矿井。

text: I don't know yet...
zh: 我还不知道……

text: There's more important things than gold.
zh: 有些东西比金币更重要。

text:
That's true...
Not only did you help Themir, but you also helped us.
zh:
说得对……
你不仅帮了塞米尔，也帮了我们。

text:
Where is he?
Why isn't he here again?
zh:
他人在哪儿？
怎么又不见他回来？

text: Goran keeps him imprisoned.
zh: 戈兰把他关起来了。

text: What?!
zh: 什么？！

text:
Is he out of his mind?
Why does he keep Randolph imprisoned?
zh:
他疯了吗？
为什么要关着兰道夫？

text: He wants me to bring him the King's Ruby.
zh: 他要我给他带去国王的红宝石。

text: I don't know.
zh: 我不知道。

text: Shame...
zh: 真可惜……

text: Maybe, we can punch out a deal.
zh: 也许我们能谈成一笔交易。

text: I am certain he wants more men in his group.
zh: 我敢肯定他想给自己的队伍添些人手。

text: If you bring him a man or two, he might let Randolph and the others go.
zh: 如果你能给他带去一两个人，他也许就会放了兰道夫他们。

text:
In case it ain't obvious, leave MY men out of this.
You better find someone somewhere else.
zh:
先把话说明白，别打我手下的主意。
你最好去别处找人。

text: Also, it might be a good idea to not let Goran know, that I suggested this.
zh: 还有，最好别让戈兰知道这主意是我出的。

text: That ol' story again?
zh: 又是那个老掉牙的故事？

text: I'll try to find them.
zh: 我去试着找找人。

text: Where can I find people for this?
zh: 我上哪儿去找这样的人？

text:
They usually don't appear out of nowhere.
Go look for them in east of here.
zh:
这种人一般不会凭空冒出来。
去东边找找吧。

text:
If we're lucky, he is already missing some of his men.
Then, you can look for them on this side of the river.
zh:
运气好的话，他手下已经走丢了几个人。
那样你就能在河这边找到他们。

text: Sure thing!
zh: 没问题！

text: I will reward your help accordingly, as soon as Randolph is back in the camp again.
zh: 等兰道夫回到营地，我自会好好酬谢你。

text: Some folks say it was buried with Weynard II in the royal crypt.
zh: 有人说它和韦纳德二世一起葬在王室墓穴里。

text:
Getting inside the crypt is the tricky part, though.
Unless you are a high-ranking royal guard, you won't be able to access it.
zh:
不过，进入墓穴才是麻烦所在。
除非你是皇家卫队的高层，否则根本进不去。

text: I have an idea of how to get Randolph out of there quicker.
zh: 我有个主意，能更快把兰道夫救出来。

text: And now you are here to make fun of me?
zh: 你现在是来看我笑话的？

text:
Listen, I went of my own accord.
There was no real fight to begin with.
zh:
听着，我是自己主动走的。
压根就没有真正打过一场。

text: If Goran and I were to fight for real back then, we would have destroyed a whole camp along each other.
zh: 要是当年我和戈兰真打起来，我们俩能把整个营地一起拆了。

text: I did not want to risk the life of our men, so I left the camp and moved here.
zh: 我不想拿弟兄们的性命冒险，所以就离开了营地，搬到了这里。

text: Now, is there anything else?
zh: 那么，还有别的事吗？

text:
Does he?
Can't expect much from him.
zh:
是吗？
对他也别抱什么指望。

text: Tell him I'll cut his pay.
zh: 告诉他，我要扣他的工钱。

text: I am #:Balder:#, the leader of this camp.
zh: 我是#:巴尔德:#，这个营地的头领。

text: Now, why are you here?
zh: 那么，你来这儿做什么？

text:
Look at that!
I didn't trust you to do that.
zh:
瞧瞧！
我本来还不信你能办成。

text:
Anyway...
Thank you for clearing the mine.
zh:
总之……
谢谢你清理了矿井。

text: Take this gold.
zh: 拿上这些金币。

text: Keep it up and you will soon be one of us.
zh: 继续保持，你很快就能成为我们的一员。

text: But why should I do that?
zh: 可我为什么要那么做？

text: Such as trust...
zh: 比如说信任……

text: And at the moment I don't trust you enough.
zh: 而眼下我还不够信任你。

text: If there's no better reason, stop wasting my time.
zh: 要是没有更好的理由，就别浪费我的时间了。

text: Come back if you can give me a good reason.
zh: 等你能给我个好理由再回来吧。

text: However, I only train the people I trust. As long as you are not a member of my bandits, I cannot teach you how to fight.
zh: 不过，我只训练我信任的人。只要你还不是我手下强盗的一员，我就不能教你怎么战斗。

text: What do you want to know?
zh: 你想知道什么？

text: Two-handed weapon training (min. 8 STR) [2 AP]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_greatsword_weapon_training_10","only_once_on_difficulty": true}
zh: 双手武器训练（需力量8）[2 技能点]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_greatsword_weapon_training_10","only_once_on_difficulty": true}

text: One-handed weapon training (min. 5 STR) [2 AP]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_sword_weapon_training_10","only_once_on_difficulty": true}
zh: 单手武器训练（需力量5）[2 技能点]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_sword_weapon_training_10","only_once_on_difficulty": true}

text: Maybe later...
zh: 以后再说吧……

text: A one-handed weapon is an extension of your arm.
zh: 单手武器就是你手臂的延伸。

text: Never neglect your training.
zh: 千万别荒废训练。

text: Don't hold your weapon too tightly when you strike and use the momentum.
zh: 挥击时别把武器握得太死，要顺势借力。

text: You're using a heavy weapon, after all. Don't try to control it too much.
zh: 毕竟你使的是重型武器，别想着完全控制它。

text:
This won't be of any use to you with spears and one-handed weapons.
Essentially, you can only use this knowledge with two-handed swords and axes.
zh:
这些对长矛和单手武器没什么用。
基本上，这套本事只适用于双手剑和双手斧。

text: With this arm you should deliver precise strikes and hit your opponent's weak points.
zh: 用这条手臂，你要打出精准的攻击，直击对手的弱点。

text: Let me see...
zh: 让我看看……

text: This letter is written by #:Gunthar:#?
zh: 这封信是#:贡塔尔:#写的？

text: How?!
zh: 怎么会？！

text: He writes that he wants to kill the #:Beast in the Swamp:# together with Johann.
zh: 他写道，他想和约翰一起去杀掉#:沼泽中的野兽:#。

text: And then finishes with these lines...
zh: 信的结尾是这样几句……

text: "I'm sorry, Balder. Please forgive me for leaving you, Goran and the others behind."
zh: “对不起，巴尔德。请原谅我丢下你、戈兰和其他人。”

text: "After we have slain the beast, I will go to Erstadt and start anew. Away from Grenmark and away from the king."
zh: “杀死那头野兽之后，我会去埃尔施塔特重新开始。远离格伦马克，远离国王。”

text: Signed... Gunthar.
zh: 署名……贡塔尔。

text:
I already had a word with him.
Good work!
zh:
我已经跟他谈过了。
干得好！

text: You shall also receive a reward for this.
zh: 你也该为此得到一份酬劳。

text:
Jens just recently found this piece of paper in the forest.
This appears to be a permit into the capital, which you can have if you want.
zh:
延斯前不久在森林里捡到了这张纸。
看样子是进入王都的通行证，你想要的话就拿去吧。

text: Alternatively, you can have some gold for your journey.
zh: 或者，你也可以拿些金币当盘缠。

text: The permit to the capital sounds great.
zh: 王都通行证听起来不错。

text: Gold is fine with me.
zh: 给我金币就行。

text: I don't need anything. I am here to help.
zh: 我什么都不需要。我是来帮忙的。

text:
Impressive! Impressive indeed.
We could use more men like you.
zh:
了不起！真是了不起。
我们正缺你这样的人手。

text:
Everyone has to watch their own backs.
Take these 250 gold coins.
zh:
各人都得自己顾好自己。
拿上这250枚金币吧。

text:
Good!
You'll need it if you want to get into the capital.
zh:
好！
想进王都的话，你会用得上它的。

text: Is there anything else?
zh: 还有别的事吗？

text:
You've really accomplished quite a bit.
I'm impressed!
zh:
你确实办成了不少事。
真让我刮目相看！

text: I need more people like you.
zh: 我需要更多像你这样的人。

text:
If you join us, you won't be accepted into any other faction.
So be sure about it!
zh:
一旦加入我们，其他势力就不会再接纳你了。
所以想清楚！

text: Do you still want to join my camp?
zh: 你还想加入我的营地吗？

text: Yes! I want to be a member of your camp.
zh: 是的！我想成为你营地的一员。

text: I need to think about it.
zh: 我得考虑考虑。

text:
Good!
Let me know when you're ready.
zh:
好！
准备好了就告诉我。

text:
That's what I wanted to hear from you!
From now on, you're a member of our camp.
zh:
这才是我想听到的！
从现在起，你就是我们营地的一员了。

text: Welcome!
zh: 欢迎！

text: Wear this armor as a sign that you are one of us.
zh: 穿上这身护甲，作为你是我们一员的标志。

text:
You joined the Royal Guard?
Then I must have been mistaken about you.
zh:
你加入了皇家卫队？
那看来是我看错你了。

text:
Listen! As long as you don't betray us, I'll allow you to stay here in the camp.
After all, I have nothing against you.
zh:
听着！只要你不背叛我们，我就允许你留在营地里。
毕竟，我对你没什么意见。

text:
But if you ever get the idea to tell the king about me, we're out of here.
And you'll end up on my list.
zh:
但你要是敢起念头向国王告发我，我们就立刻转移。
而你也会上我的黑名单。

text: If you really want to join us, you have to prove that we can trust you.
zh: 如果你真想加入我们，就得证明你值得信任。

text: What can I do for you?
zh: 我能为你做些什么？

text: There's something else I want to know.
zh: 我还有别的事想知道。

text: Yes? What is it?
zh: 嗯？什么事？

text:
Straight to the point?
I like that!
zh:
开门见山？
我喜欢！

text: For some time now, the king has been increasingly searching for bandits and has them executed.
zh: 最近这段时间，国王越来越频繁地搜捕强盗，抓到就处决。

text: However, this is not a task I will give to anyone.
zh: 不过，这任务我可不会随便交给谁。

text: Prove yourself useful to the camp, and I will tell you about the task.
zh: 先为营地证明你的价值，我再告诉你任务的内容。

text: Overall, I don't think this is bad. Many of the bandits around the capital are attacking citizens and merchants, which is why they can hardly leave the city on their own anymore.
zh: 总体来说，我不觉得这是坏事。王都附近的许多强盗袭击平民和商人，害得他们几乎不敢独自出城。

text:
But we have nothing in common with such scum. 
Not even Goran would threaten defenseless citizens.
zh:
但我们和那种人渣毫无共同之处。
就连戈兰也不会威胁手无寸铁的平民。

text: I want you to find out what plans the king, or rather the royal guard, has.
zh: 我要你查清国王——或者说皇家卫队——有什么计划。

text: What should I do?
zh: 我该做什么？

text: You are dead?
zh: 你不是死了吗？

text: I will find out about the king's plans.
zh: 我会查清国王的计划。

text: This seems tricky. I need to think about it.
zh: 这事儿有点棘手。我得考虑考虑。

text: The king, however, doesn't seem to care, which is why we're on the hit list, too.
zh: 可国王似乎并不在乎，所以我们也上了他的清剿名单。

text:
It would be best if you spoke to his advisor in the capital about it.
The king himself is unlikely to speak to someone like you.
zh:
这事你最好去王都找他的顾问谈。
国王本人可不太可能搭理你这样的人。

text: I don't want to be rude, but without an audience or a good reason, Weynard will reject you immediately.
zh: 恕我直言，没有觐见许可或正当理由，韦纳德会立刻把你拒之门外。

text:
The royal guard might also know something.
Ask the guards about their duties. In the best case, someone is directly involved in the search for the bandits.
zh:
皇家卫队可能也知道些什么。
去问问卫兵们的职责。运气好的话，正好有人直接参与搜捕强盗的行动。

text:
Oh... and one more small detail.
Never mention my name to the guards or the king.
zh:
哦……还有个小细节。
千万别在卫兵或国王面前提起我的名字。

text: They think I'm dead, and I'd like to keep it that way.
zh: 他们以为我死了，我也希望一直这样。

text: Alright.
zh: 好的。

text:
Very good!
With this task, you can prove to us that we can trust you.
zh:
很好！
完成这个任务，你就能证明自己值得我们信任。

text: It will also help me figure out how we're going to proceed with the camp.
zh: 这也能帮我想清楚营地接下来该怎么走。

text: Do I look dead to you?
zh: 你看我像死人吗？

text:
That's too long a story to tell you now.
Finish your tasks first, then we can talk about it.
zh:
这说来话长，现在没法讲给你听。
先完成你的任务，然后我们再谈。

text: I want you to find out what plans the king, or rather the royal guard, has, and why they are increasingly searching for bandits.
zh: 我要你查清国王——或者说皇家卫队——有什么计划，以及他们为什么越来越频繁地搜捕强盗。

text: I want you to find out what plans the king, or rather the royal guard, has, and why they are increasingly searching for bandits.
zh: 我要你查清国王——或者说皇家卫队——有什么计划，以及他们为什么越来越频繁地搜捕强盗。

text:
You've already proven to me that we can trust you.
Make yourself useful around the camp a little longer, and I'll be happy to accept you as a bandit.
zh:
你已经向我证明了你值得信任。
再为营地多出些力，我就很乐意接纳你成为强盗的一员。

text:
Not bad!
What can you tell me about the plans?
zh:
不赖！
关于那些计划，你都打听到了什么？

text: The king is going to search for bandits in a large area.
zh: 国王打算在大范围内搜捕强盗。

text:
Damn!
That means the Royal Guard will arrive here sooner or later.
zh:
该死！
这么说皇家卫队迟早会找到这儿来。

text: Did you find out anything else?
zh: 你还查到别的了吗？

text: All the bandits’ valuables end up with the quartermaster.
zh: 强盗的值钱物品最后都交到军需官手里。

text: The quartermaster brings all documents to the king immediately.
zh: 军需官会把所有文件立即呈给国王。

text: The leader of the bandits is unknown.
zh: 强盗头领的身份不明。

text: That's all.
zh: 就这些。

text: From this, I assume that the king is not only concerned about the bandits.
zh: 由此我推断，国王在意的不只是强盗。

text: Notes or plans would definitely be a great help in the fight against the bandits.
zh: 笔记或计划书对剿匪肯定大有帮助。

text:
I already thought so.
If the bandits' leader was known, they would attempt a targeted attack.
zh:
我早就料到了。
如果强盗头领的身份暴露了，他们就会发动针对性的袭击。

text: It seems he is searching for something specific that he believes is among them.
zh: 看来他在找某样特定的东西，而且他认为那东西就在强盗手里。

text: Did you find out anything else?
zh: 你还查到别的了吗？

text: However, I can well imagine that he is looking for something else among the documents.
zh: 不过，我很怀疑他其实是想在那些文件里找别的东西。

text: By doing this, you have proven to me and everyone else in the camp that we can trust you.
zh: 这么一来，你已经向我和营地里的所有人证明了你值得信任。

text:
Plus, you showed us you've got what it takes.
That's worth a lot here.
zh:
而且你也让我们见识到了你的本事。
这在这里可值不少分量。

text:
As far as I'm concerned, you can join us.
If you can convince the others, I'll gladly count you among my bandits.
zh:
就我而言，你可以加入我们。
只要你能说服其他人，我很乐意把你算作我手下的强盗。

text:
As you are now a member of my bandits, I'll teach you how to master the various weapons.
Let me know if you want to train.
zh:
既然你现在是我手下强盗的一员，我就教你掌握各种武器。
想训练的时候告诉我。

text: Good!
zh: 好！

text: Now that you are here, you may well make yourself useful.
zh: 既然你来了，正好可以派上用场。

text: #:Themir:# - our wizard - is missing.
zh: #:塞米尔:#——我们的法师——失踪了。

text:
What?!
Are you kidding me?
zh:
什么？！
你在开玩笑吗？

text: Where is he?!
zh: 他在哪儿？！

text: Themir lies in a cave west of here.
zh: 塞米尔躺在西边的一个洞穴里。

text:
Thank you for finding him.
Now go. I must contemplate what comes next.
zh:
谢谢你找到了他。
去吧。我得好好想想接下来怎么办。

text: Then you're free to ask him about any coin you like.
zh: 到时候你想问他什么硬币都随你。

text: Maybe you've got what it takes to become one of my men.
zh: 也许你有本事成为我的手下。
